pairing_unit: one trained run per (model, horizon, seed); paired across arms on identical horizon AND seed
unmatched_seeds_treatment: champion seeds without a baseline counterpart are excluded from paired tests; they are still reported in the per-arm descriptive statistics

holm_family.definition: all paired champion-vs-baseline tests across 4 horizons x 2 metrics (MSE, MAE)

pseudo_replication: none: each cell is an independent run with its own checkpoint; no repeated measurement of one run is reused as independent
wording_rule: use 'observed best' unless a specific comparison is supported by a Holm-corrected p-value
